headline: Marketing Consultant Cost: Rates, Models & What to Expect (2026)
description: Marketing consultants cost $100-$300/hr or $3K-$15K/mo. Compare hourly, retainer, and project rates — plus how to find vetted experts fast.

mainEntity.name: Is it cheaper to hire a marketing consultant or an agency?

acceptedAnswer.text: A marketing consultant typically costs $3,000-$15,000 per month for a dedicated senior specialist. Agencies charge $5,000-$25,000 per month but often spread your budget across junior staff. Consultants give you a named expert for less total cost — with no account-manager middleman between you and the person doing the work. The tradeoff: agencies cover more channels simultaneously, while consultants go deeper on fewer.

mainEntity.name: How much does a freelance marketing consultant charge per hour?

acceptedAnswer.text: Freelance marketing consultants charge $50-$350 per hour depending on specialization and experience. Generalists on broad platforms like Upwork charge $50-$100/hour. Vetted specialists through curated marketplaces like MarketerHire charge $100-$250/hour. Fractional CMOs and senior strategists command $200-$350/hour for high-level advisory work and board-level strategy.

mainEntity.name: What is a fractional marketing consultant?

acceptedAnswer.text: A fractional marketing consultant is a senior marketing expert who works part-time — typically 10-20 hours per week — inside your company. They provide strategic leadership, manage existing team members or vendors, and execute high-priority initiatives at 30-50% of the cost of a full-time CMO. Most fractional CMOs charge $5,000-$15,000 per month.

mainEntity.name: How long should you hire a marketing consultant for?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most marketing consultant engagements run 3-6 months minimum to produce meaningful results. Brand strategy projects can wrap in 6-8 weeks. Ongoing channel management (paid media, SEO, content) works best as a month-to-month engagement reviewed quarterly. Start with a defined trial period — at MarketerHire, that's 2 weeks — then extend or adjust based on what the data tells you.

mainEntity.name: Can you hire a marketing consultant for a single project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Project-based marketing consultant engagements typically cost $5,000-$50,000 depending on scope. Common single projects include marketing audits ($5,000-$15,000), go-to-market strategy ($10,000-$25,000), website and funnel redesign ($15,000-$50,000), and brand positioning ($8,000-$20,000). Define deliverables and timelines upfront to keep costs predictable and avoid open-ended billing.
